value.rationale: The two statistics quantify distinct natural extreme spacing properties (one exceptionally empty arc versus two jointly long adjacent arcs). Exact negative finite-sample dependence contrasts with an eventually positive, sharply quantified residual despite asymptotic weak independence. The result identifies a structural normalization-versus-rare-overlap competition rather than a renamed marginal extreme law; no unproved finite transition uniqueness is advertised.
